key_insight: ACPO stabilizes RL training by clipping the product of the importance-sampling ratio and advantage, instead of clipping the ratio alone.
engineering_relevance: For LLM post-training, this can improve both optimization stability and sample efficiency on math reasoning tasks compared with PPO/GRPO.
method: Clip the IS-ratio × advantage term to reduce unstable gradient updates.
Relate the approach to gradient clipping in policy mirror descent (PMD).
Provide convergence results for clipped-PMD under standard RL assumptions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluations on standard mathematical reasoning benchmarks, with ACPO improving accuracy by about 4–6 percentage points and boosting training efficiency over PPO and GRPO.
watch_item: Performance may depend on careful tuning of the clipping threshold and on-policy/off-policy reuse settings to avoid bias or under-updating.
paper_title: Towards Better Training Signal: Advantage Clipped Policy Optimization
